message: Assalamu Alaikum, tomorrow is the last date for FMB payment. Please clear your dues at the earliest. JazakAllah.
Reminder: Sabaq session is scheduled for Sunday at 10 AM. All children must attend.
Wa'az Mubarak will be held on Thursday at Masjid at 9:30 PM. All mumineen are requested to attend.
Annual General Meeting will be held on 25th November. Attendance is mandatory.
Water supply maintenance scheduled for tomorrow. Please store water in advance.
Eid-ul-Adha Mubarak to all mumineen. Namaz timings: 7:00 AM and 8:30 AM.
Emergency meeting regarding hall renovation. Please be at office by 6 PM today.
Community health camp organized on 28th November. Free checkup for all mumineen.
Mohalla cleanup drive this Saturday. Please participate with family.
Collection drive for Qardan Hasana starts this week. Contact masool for details.
